title: ほんの少しのキッカケ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a day out, Tosen Jordan passes me her phone to show me a picture of a hot spring inn.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Isn't this place awesome? I wanna go sometime! And by sometime, I mean let's go already!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You can eat at the restaurant without even staying there, and it looks totally fire! C'mon, let's just go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The inn seems pretty far away. I tell her we should go when we have more free time, but…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: We'll be there super fast if we take the train. Besides, the rule is that when you wanna go somewhere, you should go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a long train ride, we arrive at the inn and are greeted by one of the staff. We tell her we're just here for food…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Really? You'll even prepare fish that we catch and bring in ourselves?!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's one of the special services we offer. We prepare and serve the fish right in front of you. Are you interested?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Am I?! Wow! Yeah, let's gooo!
choice_data_list: But we don't have much time today…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What? You mean you wanna come all the way out here and not do it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You've gotta follow the good eats! There's, like, literally no other choice!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At Tosen Jordan's insistence, we head to the nearby coast to do some fishing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No way! You got another one?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: How come you're the only one who can catch any?!
choice_data_list: Let's head back since we've got some.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What? We can't go back yet. I can't let it end like this!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to lose… I just need to cast closer to the deep part!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, as if I don't know tha—gyah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: SPLASH!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry… I knocked you into the water.
choice_data_list: I'm just a little wet. It's fine.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No, it's not fine. This isn't good. We have to dry you off quick before you catch a cold!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Okay. I borrowed a robe, some towels, and a dryer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan silently dries my hair with the towel and hair dryer.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Is it too hot?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …'Kay.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, right… So, uh, the hotel person said they'd get the hot spring ready. Why don't you go take a dip?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'll just… do whatever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's playing it calm, but I can tell she's actually upset. What should I say to her?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's playing it calm, but I can tell she's actually upset. What should I say to her?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You should be angry with me! I've totally been dragging you around.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I stuffed my face, forced you here, made you exhausted… made you protect me, and knocked you into the water…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No matter how you swing it, it's not cool.
choice_data_list: I'm just happy you were happy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And me being happy is exactly what caused you so much trouble! That's how you ended up in the ocean!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Are you stupid or something? Seriously…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite what she says, Tosen Jordan looks happy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Of course I am. I mean, look at what happened.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: When something like this happens, all I can think to do is write out an apology… Should I?
choice_data_list: No need for that. Just try not to catch a cold, okay?
No need for that. Just try not to catch a cold, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Are you still worrying about me? What is up with you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, seriously… Talk about being a goody-goody.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan doesn't talk much after that, as if she's mulling something over.
